gallup_definition: Telling the truth, even when it's hard
Taking ownership of your actions and doing what you are expected to do
Acting consistently with your values, even when no one is watching
Giving all people equal treatment and opportunity
Making sure rules and decisions don't unfairly favor some people over others
Deciding to do what's right in the face of personal cost
Not acting like you are better or more important than others
Being polite and considerate toward others
Showing care and compassion toward others
Caring about your country and wanting it to live up to its ideals
Being able to live, speak, and make choices without unfair limits
Helping others and contributing to your community or country
